name: El Burgo Ranero (Spain)
description: Quartered purple and white, the purple quarters each charged with a white scallop shell and the white quarters each with a green frog's-leg plant (three leaves).
history: Municipal flag of El Burgo Ranero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: scallop shells in the purple quarters
three-leaved plants in the white quarters
